stories.title: Remembrance Day ceremony in New Ross steeped in military tradition
stories.summary: About 300 people gathered around what's considered Nova Scotia's oldest cenotaph this Remembrance Day to pay tribute to the men and women who served and died in the line of duty.

stories.title: Intimate partner violence up 15% over 8 years in Canada, StatCan says
stories.summary: Intimate partner violence rates are rising across the country, according to Statistics Canada, following an influx of what some experts are calling "anti-feminist backlash."

stories.title: Atlantic Canadian padres honour Wainwright soldiers in Remembrance Day speeches
stories.summary: Two padres in Atlantic Canada led their Remembrance Day speeches on Wednesday with reflections on the recent deadly fire at CFB Wainwright, in Alberta.

stories.title: Rural N.S. patients worry as medical ride program comes to an end
stories.summary: Nova Scotia Health said that "between exhausting federal funds and the complexities of rural, non-medical transportation, the program quickly became unsustainable."

stories.title: Wartime mystery solved as divers find wreck of ship torpedoed by German U-boat
stories.summary: The steamboat was heading from Barbados to New Brunswick in December 1944 when it was torpedoed by a German U-boat. Its wreckage was found this year.

stories.title: N.S. group apologizes for inviting convicted killer to speak at panel
stories.summary: The Elizabeth Fry Society of Mainland Nova Scotia is now apologizing after an event included Marissa Shephard, who was convicted in the 2015 killing of a Moncton, N.B. teenager.

stories.title: N.S. man faces multiple threat and weapons charges after woman escapes home
stories.summary: RCMP in Nova Scotia have charged a man with firearm and threat-related offences after a woman escaped an alleged act of intimate partner violence.

stories.title: Halifax man charged for allegedly spiking a woman’s drink at a downtown bar
stories.summary: Officers administered Narcan, which temporarily reverses the effects of an opioid overdose, and she was taken to hospital.

stories.title: Many workers in Nova Scotia, New Brunswick earning below living wage
stories.summary: Two separate reports on the living wages in New Brunswick and Nova Scotia reveal big gaps between what people need to earn just to get by and what they're actually taking home.

stories.title: FBI tip about child sexual exploitation leads to charges in Nova Scotia
stories.summary: RCMP say a Tennessee-based investigation identified a Halifax-area man who is believed to have posted child sexual abuse and exploitation material online.
